versos.hebraico: וַיַּבְדֵּ֣ל דָּוִיד֩ וְשָׂרֵ֨י הַצָּבָ֜א לַעֲבֹדָ֗ה לִבְנֵ֤י אָסָף֙ וְהֵימָ֣ן וִֽידוּת֔וּן הנביאים בְּכִנֹּר֥וֹת בִּנְבָלִ֖ים וּבִמְצִלְתָּ֑יִם וַֽיְהִי֙ מִסְפָּרָ֔ם אַנְשֵׁ֥י מְלָאכָ֖ה לַעֲבֹדָתָֽם׃

controles.web: Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with stringed instruments, and with cymbals: and the number of those who did the work according to their service was:
controles.kjv: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:
controles.livre: Assim Davi e os príncipes do exército apartaram para o ministério a os filhos de Asafe, e de Hemã, e de Jedutum, os quais profetizassem com harpas, saltérios, e címbalos: e o número deles foi, de homens idôneos para a obra de seu ministério

versos.hebraico: לִבְנֵ֣י אָסָ֗ף זַכּ֧וּר וְיוֹסֵ֛ף וּנְתַנְיָ֥ה וַאֲשַׂרְאֵ֖לָה בְּנֵ֣י אָסָ֑ף עַ֚ל יַד־אָסָ֔ף הַנִּבָּ֖א עַל־יְדֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

controles.web: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asharelah, the sons of Asaph, under the hand of Asaph, who prophesied after the order of the king.
controles.kjv: Of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph, which prophesied according to the order of the king.
controles.livre: Dos filhos de Asafe: Zacur, José, Netanias, e Asarela, filhos de Asafe, sob a direção de Asafe, o qual profetizava à ordem do rei.

versos.hebraico: לִידוּת֑וּן בְּנֵ֣י יְדוּת֡וּן גְּדַלְיָ֡הוּ וּצְרִ֡י וִֽ֠ישַׁעְיָהוּ חֲשַׁבְיָ֨הוּ וּמַתִּתְיָ֜הוּ שִׁשָּׁ֗ה עַל֩ יְדֵ֨י אֲבִיהֶ֤ם יְדוּתוּן֙ בַּכִּנּ֔וֹר הַנִּבָּ֕א עַל־הֹד֥וֹת וְהַלֵּ֖ל לַיהוָֽה׃ס

controles.web: Of Jeduthun; the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun with the harp, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the Lord.
controles.livre: De Jedutum: os filhos de Jedutum, Gedalias, Zeri, Jesaías, Hasabias, e Matitias, e Simei: seis, sob a mão de seu pai Jedutum, o qual profetizava com harpa, para celebrar e louvar a o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: לְהֵימָ֑ן בְּנֵ֣י הֵימָ֡ן בֻּקִּיָּ֡הוּ מַתַּנְיָ֡הוּ עֻ֠זִּיאֵל שְׁבוּאֵ֨ל וִֽירִימ֜וֹת חֲנַנְיָ֣ה חֲנָ֗נִי אֱלִיאָ֤תָה גִדַּ֨לְתִּי֙ וְרֹמַ֣מְתִּי עֶ֔זֶר יָשְׁבְּקָ֣שָׁה מַלּ֔וֹתִי הוֹתִ֖יר מַחֲזִיאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Of Heman; the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth.
controles.kjv: Of Heman: the sons of Heman; Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti–ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth:
controles.livre: De Hemã: os filhos de Hemã, Buquias, Matanias, Uziel, Sebuel, Jeremote, Hananias, Hanani, Eliata, Gidalti, Romanti-Ezer, Josbecasa, Maloti, Hotir, e Maaziote.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־אֵ֨לֶּה בָנִ֜ים לְהֵימָ֗ן חֹזֵ֥ה הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ בְּדִבְרֵ֥י הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים לְהָרִ֣ים קָ֑רֶן וַיִּתֵּ֨ן הָאֱלֹהִ֜ים לְהֵימָ֗ן בָּנִ֛ים אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר וּבָנ֥וֹת שָׁלֽוֹשׁ׃

controles.web: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
controles.kjv: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
controles.livre: Todos estes foram filhos de Hemã, vidente do rei em palavras de Deus, para exaltar o poder seu: e deu Deus a Hemã catorze filhos e três filhas.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־אֵ֣לֶּה עַל־יְדֵי֩ אֲבִיהֶ֨ם בַּשִּׁ֜יר בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֗ה בִּמְצִלְתַּ֨יִם֙ נְבָלִ֣ים וְכִנֹּר֔וֹת לַעֲבֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים עַ֚ל יְדֵ֣י הַמֶּ֔לֶךְס אָסָ֥ף וִידוּת֖וּן וְהֵימָֽן׃

controles.web: All these were under the hands of their father for song in Yahweh’s house, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and harps, for the service of God’s house; Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the order of the king.
controles.kjv: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of the Lord, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the king’s order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.
controles.livre: E todos estes estavam sob a direção de seu pai na música, na casa do SENHOR, com címbalos, saltérios e harpas, para o ministério do templo de Deus, por disposição do rei acerca de Asafe, de Jedutum, e de Hemã.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֤י מִסְפָּרָם֙ עִם־אֲחֵיהֶ֔ם מְלֻמְּדֵי־שִׁ֖יר לַיהוָ֑ה כָּל־הַ֨מֵּבִ֔ין מָאתַ֖יִם שְׁמוֹנִ֥ים וּשְׁמוֹנָֽה׃

controles.web: The number of them, with their brothers who were instructed in singing to Yahweh, even all who were skillful, was two hundred eighty-eight.
controles.kjv: So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the Lord, even all that were cunning, was two hundred fourscore and eight.
controles.livre: E o número deles com seus irmãos instruídos em música do SENHOR, todos os aptos, foi duzentos oitenta e oito.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּפִּ֜ילוּ גּוֹרָל֣וֹת מִשְׁמֶ֗רֶת לְעֻמַּת֙ כַּקָּטֹ֣ן כַּגָּד֔וֹל מֵבִ֖ין עִם־תַּלְמִֽיד׃פ

controles.web: They cast lots for their offices, all alike, as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.
controles.kjv: And they cast lots, ward against ward, as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.
controles.livre: E lançaram sortes para os turnos do serviço, entrando o pequeno com o grande, o mesmo o mestre que o discípulo.

versos.hebraico: וַיֵּצֵ֞א הַגּוֹרָ֧ל הָרִאשׁ֛וֹן לְאָסָ֖ף לְיוֹסֵ֑ף גְּדַלְיָ֨הוּ֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י הֽוּא־וְאֶחָ֥יו וּבָנָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: Now the first lot came out for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah; he and his brothers and sons were twelve:
controles.kjv: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah, who with his brethren and sons were twelve:
controles.livre: E a primeira sorte saiu por Asafe, a José: a segunda a Gedalias, quem com seus irmãos e filhos foram doze;

versos.hebraico: הַשְּׁלִשִׁ֣י זַכּ֔וּר בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: the third to Zaccur, his sons and his brothers, twelve:
controles.kjv: The third to Zaccur, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
controles.livre: A terceira a Zacur, com seus filhos e seus irmãos, doze;

versos.hebraico: הָרְבִיעִי֙ לַיִּצְרִ֔י בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: the fourth to Izri, his sons and his brothers, twelve:
controles.kjv: The fourth to Izri, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
controles.livre: A quarta a Izri, com seus filhos e seus irmãos, doze;

versos.hebraico: הַחֲמִישִׁ֣י נְתַנְיָ֔הוּ בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve:
controles.kjv: The fifth to Nethaniah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
controles.livre: A quinta a Netanias, com seus filhos e seus irmãos, doze;

versos.hebraico: הַשִּׁשִּׁ֣י בֻקִּיָּ֔הוּ בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: the sixth to Bukkiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve:
controles.kjv: The sixth to Bukkiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
controles.livre: A sexta a Buquias, com seus filhos e seus irmãos, doze;

versos.hebraico: הַשְּׁבִעִ֣י יְשַׂרְאֵ֔לָה בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: the seventh to Jesharelah, his sons and his brothers, twelve:
controles.kjv: The seventh to Jesharelah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
controles.livre: A sétima a Jesarela, com seus filhos e seus irmãos, doze;

versos.hebraico: הַשְּׁמִינִ֣י יְשַֽׁעְיָ֔הוּ בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve:
controles.kjv: The eighth to Jeshaiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
controles.livre: A oitava a Jesaías, com seus filhos e seus irmãos, doze;

versos.hebraico: הַתְּשִׁיעִ֣י מַתַּנְיָ֔הוּ בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve:
controles.kjv: The ninth to Mattaniah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
controles.livre: A nona a Matanias, com seus filhos e seus irmãos, doze;

versos.hebraico: הָעֲשִׂירִ֣י שִׁמְעִ֔י בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: the tenth to Shimei, his sons and his brothers, twelve:
controles.kjv: The tenth to Shimei, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
controles.livre: A décima a Simei, com seus filhos e seus irmãos, doze;

versos.hebraico: עַשְׁתֵּֽי־עָשָׂ֣ר עֲזַרְאֵ֔ל בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons and his brothers, twelve:
controles.kjv: The eleventh to Azareel, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
controles.livre: A décima primeira a Azareel, com seus filhos e seus irmãos, doze;

versos.hebraico: הַשְּׁנֵ֤ים עָשָׂר֙ לַחֲשַׁבְיָ֔ה בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve:
controles.kjv: The twelfth to Hashabiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
controles.livre: A décima segunda a Hasabias, com seus filhos e seus irmãos, doze;

versos.hebraico: לִשְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ שֽׁוּבָאֵ֔ל בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: for the thirteenth, Shubael, his sons and his brothers, twelve:
controles.kjv: The thirteenth to Shubael, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
controles.livre: A décima terceira a Subael, com seus filhos e seus irmãos, doze;

versos.hebraico: לְאַרְבָּעָ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ מַתִּתְיָ֔הוּ בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: for the fourteenth, Mattithiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve:
controles.kjv: The fourteenth to Mattithiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
controles.livre: A décima quarta a Matitias, com seus filhos e seus irmãos, doze;

versos.hebraico: לַחֲמִשָּׁ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ לִֽירֵמ֔וֹת בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: for the fifteenth to Jeremoth, his sons and his brothers, twelve:
controles.kjv: The fifteenth to Jeremoth, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
controles.livre: A décima quinta a Jeremote, com seus filhos e seus irmãos, doze;

versos.hebraico: לְשִׁשָּׁ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ לַחֲנַנְיָ֔הוּ בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: for the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve:
controles.kjv: The sixteenth to Hananiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
controles.livre: A décima sexta a Hananias, com seus filhos e seus irmãos, doze;

versos.hebraico: לְשִׁבְעָ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ לְיָשְׁבְּקָ֔שָׁה בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: for the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons and his brothers, twelve:
controles.kjv: The seventeenth to Joshbekashah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
controles.livre: A décima sétima a Josbecasa, com seus filhos e seus irmãos, doze;

versos.hebraico: לִשְׁמוֹנָ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ לַחֲנָ֔נִי בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: for the eighteenth to Hanani, his sons and his brothers, twelve:
controles.kjv: The eighteenth to Hanani, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
controles.livre: A décima oitava a Hanani, com seus filhos e seus irmãos, doze;

versos.hebraico: לְתִשְׁעָ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ לְמַלּ֔וֹתִי בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: for the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons and his brothers, twelve:
controles.kjv: The nineteenth to Mallothi, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
controles.livre: A décima nona a Maloti, com seus filhos e seus irmãos, doze;

versos.hebraico: לְעֶשְׂרִים֙ לֶֽאֱלִיָּ֔תָה בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: for the twentieth to Eliathah, his sons and his brothers, twelve:
controles.kjv: The twentieth to Eliathah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
controles.livre: A vigésima a Eliata, com seus filhos e seus irmãos, doze;

versos.hebraico: לְאֶחָ֤ד וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ לְהוֹתִ֔יר בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: for the one and twentieth to Hothir, his sons and his brothers, twelve:
controles.kjv: The one and twentieth to Hothir, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
controles.livre: A vigésima primeira a Hotir, com seus filhos e seus irmãos, doze;

versos.hebraico: לִשְׁנַ֤יִם וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ לְגִדַּ֔לְתִּי בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: for the two and twentieth to Giddalti, his sons and his brothers, twelve:
controles.kjv: The two and twentieth to Giddalti, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
controles.livre: A vigésima segunda a Gidalti, com seus filhos e seus irmãos, doze;

versos.hebraico: לִשְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ לְמַ֣חֲזִיא֔וֹת בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃

controles.web: for the twenty-third to Mahazioth, his sons and his brothers, twelve:
controles.kjv: The three and twentieth to Mahazioth, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
controles.livre: A vigésima terceira a Maaziote, com seus filhos e seus irmãos, doze;

versos.hebraico: לְאַרְבָּעָ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ לְרוֹמַ֣מְתִּי עָ֔זֶר בָּנָ֥יו וְאֶחָ֖יו שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃פ

controles.web: for the four and twentieth to Romamti-Ezer, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
controles.kjv: The four and twentieth to Romamti–ezer, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve.
controles.livre: A vigésima quarta a Romanti-Ezer, com seus filhos e seus irmãos, doze.
